newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian linear bonds seen ignoring street protest.
newsitem.headline: Belgian linear bonds seen ignoring street protest.

text.p: A mass protest on Sunday against judicial bungling in Belgium's child sex abuse and murder inquiry will increase pressure on the Belgian government to react but not the bond market, dealers said on Friday.
"If you have two or three hundred thousand people on the streets the government has the obligation to get involved...But I don't think it will move the market," one trader said.

Fears about the street protests, that started on Monday when a popular magistrate was pulled off the inquiry for accepting a plate of pasta from a victim support group, were not the reason Belgian linear bonds lagged Bunds late on Friday, he said.
